description: CSS-in-JS framework with Tailwind object syntax, automatic minification, and SSR safety. The name 'csszyx' represents class names encoded in reversed sequence z→y→x (memorable and distinctive). Optimizes bundle size through tier-based class encoding and intelligent CSS variable reuse.

universal_architecture.description: csszyx is designed as a universal tool like Tailwind - supporting all major bundlers and frameworks with a single installation.

plugin_system.description: Built on unplugin for universal bundler compatibility. Single codebase, multiple bundler targets.

framework_support.description: Framework-agnostic JSX/template transformation. csszyx works with any framework that uses JSX or has template compilation.

execution_protocol.description: Mandatory protocol for AI agents when processing any csszyx-related task

step_1_task_classification.action: Analyze task and map to one or more domains via decision_matrix
step_1_task_classification.output: Array of domain IDs in priority order

step_2_sequential_validation.action: Iterate through each domain in priority_order
step_2_sequential_validation.rule: Higher priority domain has veto power over lower priority domain decisions
step_2_sequential_validation.example: Safety rules from Architectural_Core veto performance optimizations if conflict exists

step_3_conflict_resolution.action: If conflicts exist between domains, apply conflict_resolution_table

domain_decision_matrix.description: Mapping table from task keywords to domains. AI agent MUST consult this table before accessing skills.

SSR_hydration_vs_GPU_optimization.action: Apply hydration safety rules first, then optimize within constraints

syntax_sugar_vs_collision_guard.action: Reject sugar syntax if it causes hash collision

performance_vs_hygiene.action: Keep audit attributes if performance gain < 1%

Architectural_Core_&_Safety.scope: Core architecture, SSR/RSC safety, build pipeline integrity, universal plugin system

type_generation.description: Automatically scan tailwind.config.js to generate strict TypeScript union types for 'sz' prop
type_generation.output: csszyx.d.ts with literal types for all valid Tailwind classes

ast_budget_guard.detection: Recursive AST traversal with early bailout

on_exceed.mitigation: Suggest code splitting or lazy loading

rsc_boundary_guard.description: Prevent runtime helpers (_sz, __csszyx_runtime__) from leaking into React Server Components

enforcement.method: Static Graph Analysis + Module Boundary Tracking
scan_targets: monorepo symlinks (resolve to real path before scanning)

detection_algorithm.step_3: Traverse import chains from server modules
detection_algorithm.step_4: Flag any import that resolves to forbidden symbols

on_violation.error_format:
csszyxRSCViolation: {symbol} imported in Server Component {path}
  Import chain: {chain}
on_violation.example:
csszyxRSCViolation: _sz imported in Server Component app/page.tsx
  Import chain: page.tsx → utils.ts → csszyx/runtime

ssr_hydration_safety.description: Ensure mangle map synchronization between server-rendered HTML and client hydration

mangle_map_versioning.algorithm: Content-based hash of entire mangle map

hydration_guard.description: Enforce strict hydration determinism to prevent SSR/Client mismatch

abort_protocol.step_1: Terminate hydration at affected subtree root
abort_protocol.step_2: Preserve static HTML/CSS state from SSR (no re-render)
abort_protocol.step_5: Block all event handlers in subtree to prevent partial interactivity

behavior.rationale: Preserve SSR Invariant > User interactivity. Developer must fix mismatch at source.

behavior.on_mismatch: After Abort, trigger ONE-TIME client-side re-render to sync DOM with current mangle map
behavior.warning: Console warning: 'Hydration mismatch recovered via CSR. Fix root cause before production.'
behavior.limitation: Only works when global flag window.__SZ_ALLOW_CSR_RECOVERY__ = true

explicit_recovery_contract.description: Compile-time directive with cryptographic token verification to prevent tampering and ensure recovery decisions are statically provable
explicit_recovery_contract.type: Static JSX attribute with automatic token generation
explicit_recovery_contract.binding: Must be static literal, runtime expressions not allowed

validation.compile_time_check: Reject if value is not string literal 'csr' or 'dev-only'
validation.on_invalid: Fatal Build Error: 'szRecover must be static literal "csr" or "dev-only"'

token_generation.description: Build automatically generates cryptographic token for each szRecover declaration

manifest_generation.description: Build creates manifest mapping tokens to recovery configs

stripping_policy.production: Remove path info, keep only mode + component
stripping_policy.development: Include full debug info (path, line, column)

csr.description: Enable recovery in both development and production
csr.use_case: Components thoroughly tested and need recovery behavior in prod

dev-only.description: Enable recovery ONLY in development, ignore in production
dev-only.use_case: Debugging hydration issues, not ready for production

behavior.production: Attribute + token stripped, behavior like no szRecover

dev-only.warning: Console warning in dev: 'Component has dev-only recovery. Consider adding szRecover="csr" for production or fix hydration issue.'
dev-only.token_validation: Required in development, stripped in production

runtime_verification.description: Runtime verify token before allowing recovery

verification_algorithm.step_1: Read szRecover attribute from aborted subtree root

step_5.if_not_found: Log security warning + abort hydration (possible tampering)

step_6.if_mode_mismatch: Log security warning + abort hydration (possible tampering)

token_exists.on_missing: Reject: 'Recovery token missing - possible manual edit or build corruption'

token_in_manifest.on_missing: Reject: 'Invalid recovery token - possible tampering or build mismatch'

error_messages.missing_token: CSSzyxSecurityError: Recovery declared but token missing. Component: {name}
error_messages.invalid_token: CSSzyxSecurityError: Invalid recovery token. This may indicate tampering or build mismatch.

production.csr_with_valid_token: Allow EXACTLY ONE client re-render for this subtree
production.dev_only: Attribute + token stripped, behavior like strict mode (no recovery)
production.guarantee: Only re-render once with valid token, then lock state

development.csr_with_valid_token: Same as production + console info about recovery execution
development.dev_only_with_valid_token: Enable recovery + console warning about dev-only status

production.csr: KEEP both szRecover + data-sz-recovery-token (has semantic runtime effect)

tamper_detection.description: Token system prevents common tampering scenarios

devtools_edit.attack: Developer manually adds szRecover="csr" in Elements panel

build_corruption.attack: Build process corrupts szRecover="csr" to szRecover="csr "

development_mode_config.description: Build-time configuration for development experience. All settings are compile-time transforms, no runtime flags.

auto_inject_recovery.description: Automatically inject szRecover="dev-only" into components WITHOUT explicit szRecover
auto_inject_recovery.rationale: Default false to avoid false confidence. Opt-in when debugging entire app.

when_enabled.transform: Every component without szRecover → auto-inject szRecover="dev-only"
when_enabled.warning: Console warning each auto-inject: 'Auto-recovery enabled for <Component>. Add explicit szRecover if needed in prod.'

behavior.when_disabled: No transform, components behave according to explicit declarations

use_cases.exploratory_phase: Week 1-2: Enable to collect data about hydration issues
use_cases.progressive_fix: Week 3-4: Disable, manually add szRecover="dev-only" to components needing debug
use_cases.production_ready: Week 5+: Remove all dev-only, keep only szRecover="csr" for production

strict_mode.description: Enable strict hydration mode in development to test exact production behavior

when_enabled.dev_behavior: Identical to production (no auto-inject, szRecover="dev-only" ignored)
when_enabled.warning: Build warning if szRecover="dev-only" detected: 'Component has dev-only recovery which will be disabled in strict mode.'

recommended_workflow.step_1: Development with strict_mode: false, auto_inject: false/true

warning_levels.description: Console warning system to guide progressive migration

info.trigger: Auto-injected recovery or dev-only recovery used
info.format: [csszyx] Component has temporary recovery. Consider fixing hydration issue.

warn.format: [csszyx] dev-only recovery will be disabled in production.

error.trigger: Hydration abort in component WITHOUT recovery declaration
error.format: [csszyx] Hydration aborted. Add szRecover="csr" or fix issue.

escape_hatch_mechanism.description: Local escape hatch mechanism following ESLint/TSLint pattern. Allows disabling hydration guards per-file or per-block when needed.

disable_hydration_guard.effect: Automatically inject szRecover="dev-only" into next element
disable_hydration_guard.use_case: Quick debugging, third-party components, known issues

disable_file.effect: Auto-inject szRecover="dev-only" for ALL components in file
disable_file.warning: Build warning: 'File-level hydration guard disabled. Review before production.'

enable_strict.effect: Force strict mode for this element (ignore global auto_inject config)

audit_trail.description: Track directive usage for review before production
audit_trail.format: JSON Lines with location and reason

ci_validation.description: Optional CI check to prevent accidental disables in production code
ci_validation.rule: Fail CI if @csszyx-disable directives found in production branches

state_1_loading.description: Mangle map and recovery manifest not yet loaded
state_1_loading.on_timeout: If timeout and maps still missing → transition to state_2_missing

state_2_missing.description: Map or manifest does not exist or is corrupt

state_3_mismatch.description: Map exists but checksum does not match server
state_3_mismatch.detection: Compare data-sz-checksum with hash of client map

steps.step_1: Read szRecover attribute from aborted subtree root
steps.step_2: If no szRecover → Stay aborted (no recovery)
steps.step_4: If no token → Security error + stay aborted
steps.step_6: If invalid token → Security error + stay aborted
steps.step_8: If dev-only in prod → Stay aborted
steps.step_9: If csr or (dev-only in dev) → Execute ONE-TIME recovery

recovery_token_verification.description: Verify cryptographic token before allowing recovery

manifest_load.cache: Cache in memory for subsequent verifications

recovery_token_verification.on_verification_failure: Log security error + preserve abort state

dev_prod_parity_enforcement.description: Ensure detection logic identical between dev and prod. Recovery decision differs ONLY via explicit declarations (szRecover values), not via runtime flags.
dev_prod_parity_enforcement.core_guarantee: Hydration mismatch detection algorithm IDENTICAL in all environments

logging_visualization.dev: Verbose console warnings, DevTools integration, audit logs
logging_visualization.parity: Different logging OK - same decision logic

prohibited_differences.detection_algorithm: MUST be identical - same checksum validation, same state machine
prohibited_differences.runtime_branching: NO runtime flags affecting hydration outcome
prohibited_differences.global_state: NO mutable global state influencing decisions
prohibited_differences.implicit_recovery: NO automatic recovery without explicit declaration (except when auto_inject enabled via build config)

validation.ci_check: Integration test suite runs scenarios in both dev and prod mode
assertions: Detection events identical for same input
Recovery only executes when explicitly declared
Build config changes ONLY affect compile output, not runtime logic

build_config_transparency.principle: Build config settings (auto_inject, strict_mode) only affect compile-time transform, not runtime decision graph

auto_inject_enabled.runtime: Runtime sees explicit szRecover, behaves accordingly

auto_inject_disabled.runtime: Runtime sees no szRecover, behaves accordingly

example.conclusion: Runtime logic does not know about build config - only sees compiled output

migration_path.description: Progressive migration from exploratory to production-ready

phase_2_progressive_fix.goal: Fix issues or add explicit szRecover="dev-only"

phase_3_pre_production.acceptance: Zero warnings, zero aborts, or only szRecover="csr" components

build_pipeline.description: 5-phase linear pipeline with rollback support and incremental build

phases.name: JSX Transform + Recovery Token Generation
phases.output: Transformed AST with sz prop → className + recovery tokens

step_3_token_generation.description: Generate cryptographic tokens for recovery declarations

phases.rollback: Restore original AST from cache + clear token manifest

phases.name: Tailwind JIT Compilation
phases.output: CSS bundle with all used classes

phases.name: Output/Emit + Manifest Embedding
phases.input: Minified assets + mangle map + recovery manifest
phases.output: Final build artifacts with content hashing + embedded manifests

finalization.inject_checksum: Add data-sz-checksum to HTML (mangle map checksum)

embed_recovery_manifest.description: Embed recovery token manifest into HTML

finalization.content_hashing: Hash final assets for immutable caching

incremental_build_strategy.skip_logic: If cache_key unchanged, skip phase and reuse output
incremental_build_strategy.example: Edit 1 file → Only re-run phase_2 for that file + phase_3,4,5

action.step_3: Execute rollback of all previous phases in reverse order

rollback_protocol.guarantee: No partial artifacts left after rollback

parallelization.phase_3: Parallel with multi-file phase_2 (wait for all files complete)

Syntax_Parsing_&_DSL_Hardening.scope: Syntax validation, variant nesting, sugar syntax transforms

behavior_on_exceed.audit_log: Log to .csszyx/audit.log with file path and nesting chain

flattening.description: Nested keys are joined with Tailwind's ':' before JIT processing

variant_classification_logic.description: Classify variants to determine sort strategy. Uses LRU cache for performance optimization.

commutative.sort_strategy: Stable sort by breakpoint order (sm < md < lg < xl < 2xl)
commutative.rationale: Media queries have clear CSS specificity rules

conditionally_commutative.sort_strategy: Sort if no order_sensitive variants in same chain

order_sensitive.sort_strategy: NEVER sort, preserve order from source
order_sensitive.rationale: Order affects CSS specificity or selector semantics

resolution_algorithm.step_2: Classify each variant via cache lookup
resolution_algorithm.step_4: Sort commutative variants by breakpoint order
resolution_algorithm.complexity: O(n log n) worst case, O(n) average with cache

on_violation.error_format: CSSzyxSecurityError: Forbidden token '{token}' in class '{class}' at {path}:{line}:{col}

error_recovery.rationale: Ambiguous error recovery can create silent bugs

sugar_syntax_spec.description: Convenience transforms to reduce verbosity. Precedence order is critical for deterministic output.

negative_values.detection: Value starts with '-' and is number

opacity.detection: Property is opacity/bg-opacity/text-opacity AND value in range 0-1

step_4_auto_brackets.description: Automatically wrap arbitrary values in '[]' if needed
trigger_conditions: Value contains dot '.' (EXCEPT when valid Tailwind scale like '0.5')

Logic_Transformation_&_Collision_Guard.scope: Hash collision prevention, CSS variable management, conflict resolution

canonical_engine.description: Ensure each unique CSS selector has exactly 1 hash ID with zero collision probability

injective_hashing.description: Dual-hash algorithm to detect and prevent collisions

collision_detection.all_environments: Dual-hash validation in both dev and production

step_3c.if_differ: False positive → Fallback to string comparison

all_environments.rationale: Zero tolerance for collisions to ensure correctness

ci_validation.pre_merge_check: Run full hash table build and verify zero collisions

phase_a_ast_analysis.description: Assign unique integer ID to each atomic CSS property
phase_a_ast_analysis.scope: Tailwind core utilities + custom utilities from config

phase_b_hash_lookup.description: O(1) hash table lookup with collision guard

variable_isolation.description: Optimized CSS variable system with intelligent reuse and tier-based naming

naming_convention.description: Tier prefix (1 char) + content-based hash (4-5 chars) = 5-6 chars total, optimized for bundle size

global.condition: Value used in 3+ components OR defined in tailwind.config theme

component.condition: Value used in 2+ elements in same subtree
component.scope: Nearest common ancestor of elements using it

hash_generation.determinism: Same value → same hash → REUSE across elements

intelligent_reuse.description: Automatically detect and reuse variables to minimize duplication

rule_1_literal_values.condition: Value is literal (not CSS variable reference)
rule_1_literal_values.action: Do not create CSS variable, use value directly

example.rationale: Literal values < 10 chars do not need variable overhead

rule_1_literal_values.exception: If same literal appears 2+ times → promote to variable

rule_2_value_deduplication.condition: Same value used in multiple elements
rule_2_value_deduplication.action: Generate variable once, reference multiple times

example.output:
<parent style='--c-a3f2: #ff0000'>
  <div style='color: var(--c-a3f2)' />
  <span style='color: var(--c-a3f2)' />
  <button style='color: var(--c-a3f2)' />
</parent>

example.benefit: Single definition in :root, zero element-level overhead

example.guarantee: Each value gets unique variable name

implementation.component: Injected to LCA inline style with proper scoping

scope_guarantee.no_leakage: Tier prefixes (g/c/s) prevent naming conflicts across scopes
scope_guarantee.css_validity: All prefixes valid per CSS Custom Properties spec

transformation_rules.description: Handle conversion from sz object to className string with mode detection

static.condition: All values are literals (no variables, ternaries, function calls)

css_variable.condition: Some values are dynamic expressions (not finite-branch)
css_variable.example: sz={{ p: spacing, bg: 'blue-500' }} → className="p-[var(--_sz-p)] bg-blue-500" style={{ '--_sz-p': spacing }}

ternary.condition: Finite-branch conditionals (ternary, logical OR, if/else with known branches)

conflict_resolution.rule: sz prop ALWAYS wins over className for same atomic CSS property

detection.step_1: Parse both sz object and className string

example.analysis: Conflict: padding from both className ('p-1') and sz ({ p: 2 })

css_variable_auto_compile.description: Automatic CSS variable compilation for dynamic expressions
css_variable_auto_compile.trigger: Dynamic expression detected in sz prop value that is NOT a finite-branch conditional

strategy.description: Generate a static arbitrary-value Tailwind class combined with a CSS variable set via inline style
strategy.output_className: Static arbitrary-value class referencing a CSS variable, e.g. p-[var(--_sz-p)]
strategy.output_style: Inline style setting the CSS variable value, e.g. { '--_sz-p': dynamicExpr }

variable_naming.prod_format: Mangled along with other CSS variables in production build
variable_naming.no_variant: Omit variant segment for base properties: --_sz-p, --_sz-bg

color_resolver.description: Resolves Tailwind color names to their CSS variable equivalents at runtime
color_resolver.import: Auto-injected by compiler when css_variable mode is used for color properties

rsc_compatibility.description: Fully compatible with React Server Components
rsc_compatibility.reason: Output is only className (string) + style (object) — no runtime import needed
rsc_compatibility.no_client_directive: No 'use client' required for css_variable mode

color_opacity_object_form.description: Object form for specifying color with opacity on all color-accepting properties

syntax.rationale: Short and consistent key name across all color properties

not_affected.reason: These properties are primarily width values, not colors

number.rule: Number values are used bare as Tailwind opacity modifier

css_variable.rule: CSS variable references wrapped in parentheses

arbitrary_string.rule: Other string values wrapped in square brackets as arbitrary value

Performance_GPU_&_Runtime_Optimization.scope: GPU memory management, runtime efficiency, CSS optimization

will_change_engine.description: Opt-in will-change property mapping via sz prop

design_decisions.no_mutation_observer: No MutationObserver — user explicitly declares will-change
design_decisions.no_quota_management: No quota or eviction — user controls what gets will-change
design_decisions.rationale: will-change is a performance hint best controlled by the developer, not automated

css_var_hoisting.description: Hoist CSS variables to LCA (Lowest Common Ancestor) within same component scope
css_var_hoisting.rule: Hoisting is ALWAYS safe within the same component scope. CSS custom properties inherit naturally through the DOM tree, so hoisting to a parent element has no correctness risk.
css_var_hoisting.when_to_hoist: Hoist when multiple elements share an identical CSS variable name and value

algorithm.step_1: Identify all elements using the same CSS variable name+value
algorithm.step_2: Find the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) in the JSX tree
algorithm.step_3: Add the CSS variable to the LCA's style attribute
algorithm.step_4: Remove the CSS variable from each child element's style

skip_condition.condition: LCA is a Fragment (<> or React.Fragment)
skip_condition.action: Do not hoist — keep CSS variables on individual elements

zero_alloc_helper.description: Eliminate memory allocation on hot paths via compile-time arity specialization

implementation.5_plus_args: Use loop: for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) { if (args[i]) result += args[i] + ' ' }

code_generation.detection: Static analysis of argument count at call site

early_static_detection.description: Identify PURE_STATIC nodes to bypass runtime analysis

detection.step_2: Mark nodes with no dynamic dependencies

cache.storage: Embedded in compiled code as string literal

Production_Hygiene_&_DevEx.scope: Mangling, debugging tools, error reporting, audit logging

mangling_engine.strategy: Post-Tailwind Mangling with Tier-Based Deterministic Encoding
mangling_engine.description: Mangle class names AFTER Tailwind JIT compilation. Uses tier-based sequence to optimize bundle size.

encoding.rule: No ID starts with digit (CSS selector compliance). Start from z and go backwards to a, then Z to A.
encoding.rationale: Reversed sequence (z→y→x) creates memorable pattern and distinguishes from traditional a→z encoding

tiers.description: Single letter, most compact, reversed order
Three+ letters (all reversed) for very large apps

encoding_algorithm.description: Tier-based bijective mapping from index to string ID with reversed sequence

determinism.guarantee: Same input always produces same output (cross-build stability)
determinism.implementation: Sorted iteration through class map + deterministic tier-based encoding
determinism.proof: Encoding function is pure mathematical bijection

specificity_safeguard.description: Ensure mangled classes follow Tailwind CSS layer order

algorithm.step_4: Ensure layer boundaries have no cross-contamination

validation.post_mangle_check: Parse CSS and verify layer order
validation.on_violation: Fatal Build Error with detailed layer trace

attribute_stripping.description: Remove debug attributes from production HTML
attribute_stripping.implementation: AST walker removes attributes per whitelist

invalid_tokens.message: Invalid Tailwind class '{class}' at {path}:{line}. Will be passed to CSS as-is.

syntax_error.message: Syntax error in sz object at {path}:{line}:{col}

reverse_mangle_map.description: Allow reverse lookup from minified class to original selector

stripping.verification: Assert window.__CSSZYX_REVERSE_MAP__ === undefined in prod bundle

hydration_debugger.description: Visual debugging tool for hydration mismatches

attribute_injection.styling: Apply red outline via injected <style> tag

devtools_panel.description: Browser extension panel displaying hydration state

visualization.access: Chrome DevTools → Performance tab → User Timing

configuration_examples.description: Practical configuration examples for different use cases
